$ aws-login --renew
--- stdout
==> aws sso logout (ends the current Identity Center session)
Successfully signed out of all SSO profiles.
==> aws sso login --profile planlab-prod
--- stderr
login stub: failing
aws-login: login failed (exit 0); the old session is already ended, so 'planlab-prod' has no credentials until a login succeeds
--- exit 1
--- aws calls
configure list-profiles
configure get sso_session --profile planlab-prod
sso logout
sso login --profile planlab-prod
--- stamps
